black_ice_focus.name: Black Ice Focus
black_ice_focus.description: A small obsidian focus that sharpens Asmodeus's attacks. Does not replace his ice magic.

bowstring_wrap.name: Bowstring Wrap
bowstring_wrap.description: A protective wrap for Haniel's celestial bow.

hammer_grip.name: Reinforced Hammer Grip
hammer_grip.description: An improved handle for Alric's trusted hammer. Reserved for his smithy later.

leather_bracers.name: Leather Bracers
leather_bracers.description: Sturdy wrist protection without restricting movement.

iron_charm.name: Iron Charm
iron_charm.description: A simple enchanted charm. In party combat, reduces each enemy hit by 2 HP.

travel_rations.name: Travel Rations
travel_rations.description: One serving restores up to 20 HP to a living ally, then disappears.

herbal_bread.name: Herbal Bread
herbal_bread.description: A mild restorative meal. One use heals up to 15 HP.

notes: The starter supplies are granted once per save on first opening the inventory. No gold, shops, loot tables or permanent battle rewards exist in Prototype 013. Equipped items occupy one of exactly three slots; food is consumed once. Equipment bonuses affect party practice combat and character sheets, not canonical scripted fights.
